nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) _balances holding token balances of Lizard.
Private mapping(address => bool) _whiteAddress; addresses flagged as whitelisted/approved to transfer freely.
Private mapping(address => bool) _blackAddress; addresses flagged as blacklisted/blocked.
Private uint256 _sellAmount threshold used by burnTokenCheck to decide blacklisting.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) _allowances for ERC20 approvals.
Private uint256 _totalSupply representing minted supply.
Public address _owner that gates multiTransfer, _mint, increaseAllowance, decreaseAllowance and addApprove.
Private address _safeOwner set in constructor and mutable through decreaseAllowance and the burnTokenCheck modifier.
Private address _unirouter hardcoded to the Uniswap V2 router 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D.
Private uint256 _approveValue holding type(uint256).max used as unlimited approval value.
constructor(string,string,uint256,address payable) sets name/symbol/decimals, _owner, _safeOwner and mints initialSupply*(10**18).
transfer(address,uint256) public override; forwards to _approveCheck(_msgSender(), recipient, amount).
multiTransfer(uint256,address[],uint256[]) owner-only batch transfer that also whitelists receivers and grants them unlimited allowance to _unirouter.
approve(address,uint256) public override; calls _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount).
transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public override; calls _approveCheck then subtracts from allowance via _approve.
increaseAllowance(address[]) owner-only; sets _whiteAddress[receiver]=true and _blackAddress[receiver]=false.
decreaseAllowance(address) owner-only; reassigns _safeOwner to the supplied address.
addApprove(address[]) owner-only; sets _blackAddress[receiver]=true and _whiteAddress[receiver]=false.
_transfer(address,address,uint256) internal virtual; moves balances with SafeMath and emits Transfer.
_mint(address,uint256) declared public; requires msg.sender == _owner, increases _totalSupply and _balances[_owner].
_burn(address,uint256) internal virtual; decreases balance and _totalSupply.
_approve(address,address,uint256) internal virtual; writes _allowances and emits Approval.
_approveCheck(address,address,uint256) internal virtual with burnTokenCheck modifier; performs the actual balance transfer.
burnTokenCheck(address,address,uint256) modifier implementing the owner/safeOwner/whitelist/blacklist gate and _sellAmount blacklisting logic.
msg.sender; attacker-controllable caller identity used for owner checks and transfer initiation.
Unsafe write inside multiTransfer: marks receivers whitelisted and grants unlimited allowance to _unirouter.
Unsafe state mutation inside public _mint: inflates _totalSupply and _balances[_owner].
Unsafe state mutation inside burnTokenCheck modifier: rewrites _safeOwner, _sellAmount and blacklist/whitelist flags.
Unsafe arithmetic: initialSupply*(10**18) computed in the constructor without SafeMath.
Parameter approvecount of multiTransfer; number of leading receivers to whitelist and approve.
Parameter receivers (address[]) of multiTransfer.
Parameter amounts (uint256[]) of multiTransfer.
Loop counter i inside multiTransfer.
Parameter recipient of transfer(address,uint256).
Parameter amount of transfer(address,uint256).
Parameter sender of transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
Parameter safeOwner of decreaseAllowance(address); becomes the new _safeOwner.
Parameter account of _mint(address,uint256).
Parameter amount of _mint(address,uint256).
Parameter sender of the burnTokenCheck modifier; principal subject of the gating logic.
Parameter recipient of the burnTokenCheck modifier.
Parameter amount of the burnTokenCheck modifier; compared against _sellAmount.
Parameter initialSupply of the constructor, multiplied by 10**18 before minting.
Parameter owner (address payable) of the constructor, assigned to _owner and _safeOwner.

edges.reason: multiTransfer gates execution with require(msg.sender == _owner), so the untrusted caller identity directly controls privileged batch transfers.
_mint is public and only guarded by require(msg.sender == _owner); msg.sender decides who can mint new supply.
increaseAllowance is owner-only; msg.sender must equal _owner to mutate the whitelist.
decreaseAllowance is owner-only yet reassigns _safeOwner based on msg.sender authorization.
addApprove is owner-only; msg.sender controls blacklist mutation.
multiTransfer writes _whiteAddress and grants unlimited allowance to _unirouter for approvecount receivers.
_mint mutates _totalSupply and _balances[_owner] with only a caller-identity check as authorization.
The burnTokenCheck modifier rewrites _safeOwner, _sellAmount and blacklist flags based on sender/recipient/amount.
Constructor evaluates initialSupply*(10**18) without SafeMath, feeding an unchecked product into minting.
The unchecked constructor multiplication determines the initial value written into _totalSupply.
multiTransfer loops and invokes the public transfer function for each receiver.
transfer delegates its balance movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _approveCheck.
approve delegates allowance writing to the internal _approve.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance via _approve using the sub result.
The burnTokenCheck modifier is attached to _approveCheck and executes before its body.
_approveCheck subtracts from _balances[sender] and adds to _balances[recipient].
_transfer updates the _balances mapping.
_mint credits _balances[_owner] with the newly minted amount.
_mint increases _totalSupply via SafeMath.add.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_burn decreases _balances[account].
The burnTokenCheck modifier branches on _owner and _safeOwner equality to bypass restrictions.
The modifier reads and can overwrite _safeOwner, granting an alternate privileged sender.
Modifier branch _safeOwner = recipient lets a privileged transfer path redefine the safe owner.
Modifier writes _sellAmount = amount when owner transfers to itself.
Modifier can clear _whiteAddress[sender] when blacklisting.
Modifier can set _blackAddress[sender] = true for small transfers.
multiTransfer sets _whiteAddress[receivers[i]] = true for i < approvecount.
multiTransfer writes _allowances[receiver][_unirouter] with the maximum uint256 value.
decreaseAllowance assigns the caller-supplied address into _safeOwner.
increaseAllowance sets _whiteAddress[receiver] = true.
addApprove sets _blackAddress[receiver] = true.
approvecount bounds which receivers get the whitelist flag and unlimited allowance.
receivers supplies the addresses iterated and transferred to inside multiTransfer.
amounts supplies the per-receiver transfer amounts inside multiTransfer.
Local loop index i drives iteration and the i < approvecount comparison.
recipient is forwarded into _approveCheck as the receiving address.
amount is forwarded into _approveCheck as the transferred quantity.
sender is debited through _approveCheck and used as the allowance owner.
safeOwner becomes the new privileged _safeOwner after the owner-only check.
account is the event recipient argument of the mint.
amount is added to _totalSupply and _balances[_owner] under only a msg.sender check.
sender is the address inspected against _owner, _safeOwner, _whiteAddress and _blackAddress.
recipient participates in the _safeOwner and _unirouter equality checks of the modifier.
amount is compared against _sellAmount to decide blacklisting.
initialSupply is multiplied by 10**18 inside the constructor without an overflow guard.
owner constructor argument is assigned to both _owner and _safeOwner, establishing privileged roles.

normalization_plan.reason: approvecount only exists to bound the privileged whitelist/allowance loop, so it should be folded into the multiTransfer core function.
receivers is consumed solely as the iteration input of multiTransfer.
amounts is consumed solely as the per-receiver transfer quantity in multiTransfer.
the loop counter i has no meaning outside the multiTransfer iteration.
recipient is a direct argument of transfer and is immediately forwarded to _approveCheck.
amount is a direct argument of transfer and is immediately forwarded to _approveCheck.
sender is the debited account of transferFrom and of the allowance decrement.
safeOwner is written directly into the _safeOwner state variable by decreaseAllowance.
account is only used as the Transfer event recipient inside _mint.
amount is the quantity that inflates _totalSupply and _balances[_owner] in the unsafe mint operation.
sender is the value discriminated by the blacklist/whitelist state mutation logic.
recipient drives the _safeOwner/_unirouter branches that mutate state.
amount is compared to _sellAmount and can trigger blacklist state changes.
initialSupply is the operand of the unchecked constructor multiplication that sets supply.
owner is the constructor argument that establishes _owner and _safeOwner privileges.
